rows.Benefits Description.Ambulance (cont.): • All ground ambulance charges for 100 miles or greater when medically necessary treatment is available within 100 miles • Non-ambulance transportation including wheelchair van, gurney van, commercial air flights, or any other vehicle not licensed as ambulance • Air ambulance will not be covered if transport is beyond the nearest available medically suitable facility, but is requested by patient or physician for continuity of care or other reasons
